## Work for Belco If you are interested in working with us, explore the open positions below. ### **Current Open Positions:** Project Manager **Job Posting – Project Manager** At Belco Industries Inc. we are passionate about inspiring innovation around the world. We are Belco, The Systems Solutions People. As a custom machine builder in Belding, Michigan, we strive to provide the best experience for our customers. Belco proudly serves North America with the most technologically advanced products in the industry and is committed to long-term relationships. We’re there from start to finish, standing behind our products from the drawing board to the customer’s shop floor. **Position Title:** Project Manager **Summary:** The position will engage across all functions of the company and have exposure through the entire project process. The ideal candidate is interested in growing business, has superior analytical skills, is organized, and has a sense of urgency while maintaining direction, and focus. Candidates who take initiative, have a tremendous work ethic and a high level of integrity are considered ideal. Position responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Build and develop the project team to ensure maximum performance, by providing purpose, direction, and motivation. * Lead projects from requirements definition through deployment, identifying schedules, scopes, budget estimations, and implementation plans, including risk mitigation. * Coordinate internal and external resources to ensure that projects adhere to scope, schedule, and budget * Responsible for identifying potential cost savings and/or cost problems that may occur on various projects * Attends, contributes to, and/or leads meetings with team members, sales, vendors, customers and management as needed. * Use a variety of computer programs including Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, AutoCAD, Project Manager, and company’s enterprise resource planning (ERP) software. * Continuously strives for operational excellence and continuous improvement **Qualifications:** * Strong academic credentials: bachelor’s degree required * 3-4 years’ experience in Project Management role * Strong interpersonal and communication skills * Self-directed, self-motivated, hard-working, strong initiative * Ability to be adaptable in a fast-paced, working environment and adapt to changing circumstances. **NOTE:** This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other duties as required to meet the needs of the company and its customers. **Compensation:** Salary **To Apply:** Please email resume and cover letter to [bsparks@belcoind.com](mailto:bsparks@belcoind.com). ***Belco Industries Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.*** Field Installation Supervisor **Job Posting – Field Installation Supervisor** At Belco Industries Inc. we are passionate about inspiring innovation around the world. We are Belco, The Systems Solutions People. As a custom machine builder in Belding, Michigan, we strive to provide the best experience for our customers. Belco serves multiple locations nationwide and continues to proudly build not only the most technologically advanced products in the industry, but committed, long-term relationships as well. We’re there from start to finish, standing behind our products from the drawing board to the customer’s shop floor. **Position Title:** Field Installation Supervisor **Summary:** The position will engage across all functions of the company and have exposure to the entire installation process. The ideal candidate is interested in traveling to customer sites for extended periods of time and possesses strong analytical and organizational skills. Successful employees invite input from others and listen and react intellectually. Position responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Lead and coordinate the installation of systems and equipment, ensuring alignment with the project specifications and timelines. * Evaluate installation sites to determine requirements, potential challenges, and safety compliance. * Perform regular inspections and quality checks on installations to ensure compliance with industry standards and company policies. * Work closely with project managers, engineers, and customers to provide updates and resolve issues that arise during installation. * Good mechanical knowledge and welding experience. * Maintain accurate records of installation activities, including materials and labor hours. * Collaborating with the operations, accounting, sales, and engineering to gather the information needed to complete the work. * Using a variety of computer programs including Microsoft Office products and the company’s enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to create and edit process documentation such as purchase orders and bill of materials. * Recommending improvements that lower costs and/or increase production. This is a field installation supervisor position, and the qualified applicant will be required to travel frequently as a condition of employment. Travel is typically to and from job sites throughout the contiguous United States, however, travel outside of the country is sometimes required. **Qualifications:** * Strong academic credentials: High school diploma required. * Minimum 2-4 years’ experience. * Valid Driver’s License. * Demonstrates a high level of cooperation, flexibility, and willingness to help the team succeed. * Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, ambiguous working environment. * Ability to obtain a Passport. **NOTE:** This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other duties as required to meet the needs of the company and its customers. **Compensation:** Salary **To Apply:** Please contact Brian Sparks at [bsparks@belcoind.com](mailto:bsparks@belcoind.com) ***Belco Industries Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.*** Service Technician **Job Posting – Service Technician** At Belco Industries Inc. we are passionate about inspiring innovation around the world. We are Belco, The Systems Solutions People. As a custom machine builder in Belding, Michigan, we strive to provide the best experience for our customers. Belco serves multiple locations nationwide and continues to proudly build not only the most technologically advanced products in the industry, but committed, long-term relationships as well. We’re there from start to finish, standing behind our products from the drawing board to the customer’s shop floor. **Position Title:** Service Technician **Summary:** The position will engage across all functions of the company and have exposure to the entire service process. The ideal candidate is interested in traveling to customer sites and troubleshooting equipment and possesses strong analytical and organizational skills. Successful employees invite input from others and listen and react intellectually. Position responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Experience and understanding in working with Allen – Bradley PLC Control systems, this does not require the ability to write program code but does require the ability to understand and debug or troubleshoot existing machine programming with support. (Control Logics / Compact Logics). * Experience in working with variable frequency drives (Allen Bradley or Mitsubishi). * Experience working with hydraulic fluid power systems or equipment * Knowledge and understanding of basic electrical machine wiring (24VDC-480VAC) * Good mechanical knowledge and some welding experience. * Prior experience working with any type of gas combustion systems is very helpful. * Collaborating with the operations, accounting, sales, and engineering to gather the information needed to complete the work. * Prior experience in the field of Aluminum Extrusion or machine maintenance is also helpful * Using a variety of computer programs including Microsoft Office products and the company’s enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to create and edit process documentation such as purchase orders and bill of materials. * Recommending improvements that lower costs and/or increase production. This is a field service position and the qualified applicant will be required to travel frequently as a condition of employment. Travel is typically to and from job sites throughout the contiguous United States, however, travel outside of the country is sometimes required. It is the intension of Belco Industries to minimize in any way possible the technicians time away from home on weekends and evenings if possible. To this end, the technicians will most often travel to job sites on a schedule which will allow them to complete the work and be travel back home within the same week. However, jobs which require an extended stay do happen and should be understood as a condition of employment for this position. **Qualifications:** * Strong academic credentials: High school diploma required * Minimum 2-4 years’ experience * Demonstrates high level of cooperation, flexibility, and willingness to help the team succeed. * Ability to be adapt to a fast-paced, ambiguous working environment. **NOTE:** This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Belco serves multiple locations nationwide and continues to proudly build not only the most technologically advanced products in the industry, but committed, long-term relationships as well. We’re there from start to finish, standing behind our products from the drawing board to the customer’s shop floor. **Position Title:** Mechanical Engineer **Summary:** The position will engage across all functions of the company and have exposure to the entire manufacturing process. The ideal candidate is interested in engineering design, problem solving and product improvement and possesses strong analytical and organizational skills, as well as efficiency in CAD.Successful employees invite input from others and listen and react intellectually. Position responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Designing equipment to meet the needs of our customers as well as applicable codes and industry safety standards. * Using a variety of computer programs including Microsoft Office products, CAD, and the company’s enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to create and edit process documentation such as drawings (layout and detailed), Bill of Materials, and product manuals. * Recommending improvements that lower costs and/or increase production. * Engaging with the Production Team to solve problems during the fabrication process. * Using technology and creativity to continuously improve, quality, timeliness, and profitability. * Contributing to meetings with team members, customers, and suppliers to problem solve and achieve successful outcomes. * Supporting Sales Department on design concepts and cost estimates. * Leading a project from receipt of customer purchase order through equipment installation, including schedule and resource management. **Qualifications:** * Strong academic credentials: High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree preferred. * High attention to detail, fulfilling responsibilities with integrity and accuracy. * Exhibits trust and accountability. * Demonstrates high level of cooperation, flexibility, and willingness to help the team succeed. * Ability to be adapt to a fast-paced, ambiguous working environment. **NOTE:** This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other duties as required to meet the needs of the company and its customers. **Compensation:** Salary **To Apply:** Please contact Justin Swanson at [jswanson@belcoind.com](mailto:jswanson@belcoind.com) ***Belco Industries Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.*** Finishing Sales Engineer **Job Description** At Belco Industries Inc. we are passionate about inspiring innovation around the world. We are Belco, The Systems Solutions People. As a custom machine builder in Belding, Michigan, we strive to provide the best experience for our customers. Belco serves multiple locations nationwide and continues to proudly build not only the most technologically advanced products in the industry, but committed, long-term relationships as well. We’re there from start to finish, standing behind our products from the drawing board to the customer’s shop floor. **Position Title:** Finishing Sales Engineer **Position Responsibilities** The Sales Engineer will work closely with customers and internal teams to develop custom engineered solutions for finishing industrial applications. This position is ideal for someone with experience in manufacturing, industrial equipment, process engineering, or mechanical engineering who enjoys solving technical challenges and building customer relationships. Position responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Develop technical proposals, quotations, and cost estimates for custom industrial finishing systems. * Evaluate customer applications and recommend equipment, layouts, and process improvements that increase productivity, efficiency, and quality. * Identify potential cost savings and proactively address project risks throughout the quoting process. * Collaborate with engineering, project management, manufacturing, purchasing, and service teams to develop complete customer solutions. * Attend and contribute to meetings with customers, vendors, sales, and internal teams. * Utilize Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, ERP software, and other business systems to prepare proposals and manage projects. * Build and maintain strong customer relationships through technical support and effective communication. **Qualifications:** * Strong academic credentials: High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree preferred * Sales experience: 2+ Years * Strong interpersonal and communication skills * Self-directed, self-motivated, hard-working, strong initiative * Ability to be adaptable in a fast-paced, working environment and adapt to changing circumstances **NOTE:** This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other duties as required to meet the needs of the company and its customers. **Compensation:** Salary **To Apply:** Please contact our Director of Sales at [belco@belcoind.com](mailto:belco@belcoind.com) ***Belco Industries Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.*** Welder Fabricator **Job Posting – Welder Fabricator** At **Belco Industries Inc.** we are passionate about inspiring innovation around the world. **We are Belco, The Systems Solutions People.** As a custom machine builder in Belding, Michigan, we strive to provide the best experience for our customers. Belco serves multiple locations nationwide and continues to proudly build not only the most technologically advanced products in the industry, but committed, long-term relationships as well. We are there from start to finish, standing behind our products from the drawing board to the customer’s shop floor. **Position Title:** Welder Fabricator **Summary:** Belco Industries is currently seeking novice to highly experienced candidates for the position of Welder Fabricator. Novice candidates should have some prior experience in metal fabrication and welding, know how to read a tape measure, and have good mechanical aptitude, while experienced candidates should possess the ability to read and build from mechanical shop drawings. **Position responsibilities and requirements include, but are not limited to:** * The welder/fabricator position requires the ability to perform the work or tasks assigned (with some training or instruction as required) daily. This work requires the ability to interpret and build from fabrication drawings and to assemble industrial equipment or systems being manufactured. * All candidates should have basic metal fab skills necessary to perform the tasks involved – with some instruction and/or training as necessary based on experience level. * Workers will use various power tools and equipment and should have experience or familiarity with using: GMAW wire welders, plasma or flame cutters, steel saws, grinders, press brakes, plate shears, drill presses, ironworkers, forklifts, overhead cranes, etc. * The worker will be required to lift, push, pull, etc., steel, or other components (up to 50 lbs.), and stand, bend, kneel, squat, etc. in the performance of the work. The amount of lifting, standing, bending, kneeling, etc. varies constantly depending on the current work being performed. **Qualifications:** * High School Diploma and/or Technical Training with certification preferred. * High attention to detail, fulfilling responsibilities with integrity and accuracy. * Exhibits trust and accountability. * Ability to adapt to a fast-paced working environment and a willingness to learn. **NOTE:** This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may perform other duties as required to meet the needs of the company and its customers. **Compensation:** A 40-hour workweek with travel & overtime opportunities, paid annual vacation time after 12 months of employment, and 9 paid holidays per year. Medical and Dental benefits are available, as well as a 401k retirement plan with a company contribution of $.35 per hour worked and an additional matching contribution of up to $.40 per hour. The current pay rate for this position is between $15 and $24.94 per hour based on experience and ability. **To Apply:** Email resume to **Justin Swanson** at **[JSwanson@belcoind.com](mailto:JSwanson@belcoind.com)**, send by mail, or drop off at our office. ***Belco Industries Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.*** [![Extrusion Systems](/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/extrusion-systems.webp)](https://youtu.be/qC1NTgwJqjU) [(616) 794-0410](tel:16167940410) [9138 W Belding Rd, Belding, MI 48809](https://goo.gl/maps/vvoDsV7f8wG1nzPJA) [Contact Us](#) ### Services * [extrusion](/extrusion-overview/) * [Finishing](/finishing-overview/) ### Resources * [Company](/company-info/) * [blog](/blog/) ## Get a quote for your project. Company Info | Belco Industries | Custom Machine Builder
[![Finishing and Extrusion Systems Near Me](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20900%20506'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://youtu.be/qC1NTgwJqjU?autoplay=1) ## Company Info ### Our Story In 1959, four co-workers with expertise in **paint application** and [aluminum extrusions](/extrusion-overview/) decided they wanted to do more than just provide customers with typical products, install them, and walk away. They wanted to solve customers’ problems with American-made, high-tech solutions and extraordinary customer service, from development to installation and beyond. These were the forward-thinking goals that launched a new and different kind of company. It’s what set Belco apart then, and continues to set us apart today. We are Belco. The Systems Solution People. As a [custom machine builder in Belding, MI](/), we strive to always provide the best experience for our customers. [![Belco Powder Coating System](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://youtu.be/rhWppNC5IPA?autoplay=1) [![Belco Aluminum Extrusion](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://youtu.be/UxZXMSPLkCE?autoplay=1) ### Our Service Just as our founders did back in 1959, we strive to give every project the highest level of service and follow-up support. Today, from our over 70,000-square-foot facility in Belding, Michigan, Belco serves multiple locations nationwide and continues to proudly build not only the most technologically advanced products in the industry, but strong, long-term relationships as well. We’re there from start to finish, standing behind our products from the drawing board to the customer’s shop floor. Unlike others in the **aluminum extrusion** and paint industries, Belco offers flexibility, providing complete turnkey systems or when needed, retrofitting equipment and custom designing solutions to fit customer needs. We will do whatever it takes for our customers to succeed because we firmly believe that if they fail, so do we. [![Electrocoat Systems Worldwide](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://youtu.be/apzagmmgtcw?autoplay=1) [![Commercial Paint Booths Worldwide](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://youtu.be/9LSYtvei6KA?autoplay=1) [![Electrocoat Systems Worldwide](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6C8ogT6eyTo&t?autoplay=1) [![Commercial Paint Booths Worldwide](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p82C4pk5xN8&?autoplay=1) ### Our Products Belco has a reputation of being easy to work with, being available 24/7 and having the safest, most reliable and long-lasting equipment that can be found. Belco products not only set industry standards, but continuously raise the bar. Our products go above and beyond manufacturing requirements, minimize floor space, and offer the lowest operating costs possible. Our undying commitment to exceptional customer support, diversified product line, and willingness to respond to the growing and changing demands of the industries we serve makes Belco an industry leader. ### Aluminum Extrusion World renowned in the [aluminum extrusion](/extrusion-overview/) industry, Belco [aluminum extrusion products](/extrusion-overview/) and systems maximize productivity by minimizing downtime and reducing scrap. #### Products include, but are not limited to: * Billet/Log Furnaces * Furnaces * Handling Systems * Log Saws * Die Ovens * Age Ovens * Pullers * Air Quench Systems ### Finishing Our paint and [powder finishing](/powder-coating-systems/) expertise has earned us widespread respect in the industry and our products are considered top-of-the-line, ideal for manufacturers of metal furniture, automotive components, and other metal and plastic parts. #### Products include, but are not limited to: * Custom Washers * Ovens * Paint Spray Booths ## Our Promise ### Superior Products & Service [Belco Industries](/) was founded on a very basic concept…design, engineer, and manufacture quality equipment that exceeds customer expectations while offering years of dependable service. Since the beginning, Belco has manufactured literally hundreds of systems for clients, from start-up ventures to Fortune 500 companies all around the world. Whether you’re a small company or a giant corporation, we promise to provide innovative solutions that meet your unique needs and stand by them through concept, delivery, installation, and support. We’ll be there for as long as you may need us. ### Value European companies may give you a lower price, but they also give you zero flexibility, whole-system cookie-cutter designs, and lower quality service – or no service at all. At [Belco](/), it’s not just about delivering products to clients. It’s about providing value by customizing solutions to meet your needs and standing behind our products to exceed your expectations. It’s about building relationships…and building your bottom line. ### References #### Companies we’ve had the pleasure of helping: * Chrysler * Herman Miller * Pella Windows * Kaiser Aluminum * Whirlpool * Winnebago * Caterpillar * Hydro Aluminum * Knoll * General Motors * Allied Signal * Steelcase * Federal Mogul * Haworth * General Electric [![Extrusion Systems](/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/extrusion-systems.webp)](https://youtu.be/qC1NTgwJqjU) [(616) 794-0410](tel:16167940410) [9138 W Belding Rd, Belding, MI 48809](https://goo.gl/maps/vvoDsV7f8wG1nzPJA) [Contact Us](#) ### Services * [extrusion](/extrusion-overview/) * [Finishing](/finishing-overview/) ### Resources * [Company](/company-info/) * [blog](/blog/) ## Get a quote for your project.
